newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may cut Parker & Parsley.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may cut Parker & Parsley.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it is reviewing Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co for a possible downgrade pending its merger with Mesa Inc.

Parker & Parsley's senior debt is rated Triple-B and its monthly income preferred securities are rated Double-B-Plus, Duff & Phelps said. The action would affect $300 million in debt and $188.8 million in preferred securities.
Duff & Phelps said the new company will carry higher debt levels than Parker & Parsley due to the integration of Mesa's debt.
"This increase will cause the interest and debt coverage ratios to weaken; however, the company should remain in the investment grade category," Duff & Phelps said in a statement.
